macros.name: entrynumber
macros.doc: The command \entrynumber is replaced by the current entry number.

macros.name: mailnewdata
macros.doc: In case of intention of use of several databases in the same file, use the command \mailnewdata, which resets entries.

macros.name: numberofentries
macros.doc: The command \numberoffields is replaced by the number of fields and \numberofentries is replaced by the number of entries, but it is necessary two runs to update the value.
